page.overview:
Who is Angler Fish?

The Angler Fish is a giant sea monster guardian from the Atlantis theme. It is green with large blue eyes, white teeth (along with a single golden tooth) a lure and movable fins, a jaw and tail. It appeared in the set 7978 Angler Attack. The monster guards a helmet and two crystals.
